object_description: layered complex of independent building volumes
design_condition: The volumes are arranged in strata parallel to the avenue, with courtyards, access routes, and outdoor activities distributed across the site and linked by uneven walkways.

positive.statement: The grouping of independent divisions is legible from outside and helps users identify with their house.

negative.statement: The aggregation of the units remains complex and very unclear.
Too many exceptions disrupt easy identification of the different volumes.
The height-difference connection system is random and poorly controlled.
The resulting architecture is complicated and resembles an industrial production site more than an open living and working environment.
